name: MoYu Super RS3 M V2 Ball-Core UV 3x3
description: The RS3 M Super V2 Ball Core is MoYu's most feature-rich version cube in the new Super V2 series. This cube is UV coated and comes with core-corner magnets and repelling edge magnets in addition to traditional corner-edge magnets. Turning is tactile, clean, and fast. This new release is sure to impress cubers at all skill levels!
